column4: error[E0433]: cannot find module or crate `async_runtime` (built through cargo). Not obsolete under ADR-0004, but written against the wrong module name: with `use std::async` / `async::sleep_ms_blocking(10)` the program prints its expected block interpreted; plan: rename the import in the program (the compiled build is not verified), then it should pass
